hypothesis: H: a pre-TP1 trailing lock armed at a HIGHER favor threshold protects round-trippers (today's class) without scratching runners in their first minutes, because a winner that has already run +20-40% has demonstrated the move the trail is meant to protect.
cells_frozen_entire_search_space: CONTROL: live as-is (arm_scope=post_tp1, arm_pct=0.05 -- inert pre-TP1)
why_these_values_and_not_a_sweep: 0.30 is NOT picked from E1's failure -- it is the independently-derived threshold from the overnight EXIT-LEAK study (analysis/deep-research/EXIT-LEAK-2026-07-28.json): 33 losers touched >=+30% MFE and round-tripped to a stop for -$3,829.60. 0.20/0.40 bracket it as a dose-response axis. trail_pct stays 0.15, TP1 stays 1.0, everything else untouched.
dose_response_requirement: The three cells form a monotone axis. If results do NOT show coherent structure across 0.20/0.30/0.40 (e.g. one cell positive and its neighbours both sharply negative), treat the positive as NOISE and do not arm regardless of gate arithmetic. A real mechanism should degrade gracefully, not spike at one point.
multiplicity_honesty: Cumulative exit-shape cells tested this week: ~181 (edge-matrix + kitchen campaigns, 0 ships) + 4 (iteration 1) + 3 (here) = ~188. The prior on any single exit cell shipping is LOW and this pre-reg does not pretend otherwise. That is precisely why G4 is a hard veto and why the dose-response requirement exists.

arming_rule: Arm at most ONE cell, and only if it clears G1-G7. Flag-gated in the strategy exit shape, guard tests RED-proofed, REVOKE = revert the key. If none clear: record the second null, arm nothing, and escalate the exit leak to a DIFFERENT mechanism class (candidates for a future separate pre-reg, NOT tested here: minimum-hold-bars before any arm; BE floor instead of a trail; time-of-day-conditioned arming). Two nulls on the arm-threshold axis would be strong evidence that the trail mechanism itself is the wrong tool for this leak.
kill_criteria_post_arm: Forward 10 sessions or n>=8 fills; realized expectancy worse than counterfactual control -> revert.
